description: Scale-up run with 7B Qwen3-Instruct on a CUDA machine. Activations and outputs use a new experiment name so the 4B canonical extraction is never overwritten.
dtype_default_hint: auto (float16 on CUDA for weights; hidden states saved float32 on CPU)

integrity_requirements.CUDA_extra_note: If output_hidden_states=True returns aliased buffers (all layers identical per anchor), switch extraction to forward-hook based per-layer clone-to-CPU materialization, as MPS/PyTorch in some versions shares buffers.
